acceptance_criteria: All four cargo test commands exit 0. cargo clippy exits 0 with no warnings. cargo fmt --check exits 0. No uncommented unwrap() in production code paths of the five new check blocks.
close_reason: All cargo test, clippy, and fmt checks pass across pkix-path, pkix-chain, pkix-profiles. No unwrap() in production code of new policy checks. All 5 new fields have rustdoc.
description:
**What:** Verify the complete pkix-path (and dependent crate) test suites pass without modification after the five new policy fields are added and enforced.

**Algorithm:**
1. Run the full test suite for all affected crates:
   ```bash
   cargo test -p pkix-path --all-features 2>&1
   cargo test -p pkix-chain --all-features 2>&1
   cargo test -p pkix-profiles --all-features 2>&1
   cargo test -p pkix-chain-simple --all-features 2>&1
   ```
2. Also run clippy on all affected crates:
   ```bash
   cargo clippy -p pkix-path --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1
   cargo clippy -p pkix-chain --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1
   ```
3. Run rustfmt check:
   ```bash
   cargo fmt -p pkix-path -- --check 2>&1
   ```
4. Verify no new `unwrap()` calls were introduced in non-test code:
   ```bash
   grep -n 'unwrap()' pkix-path/src/lib.rs | grep -v '// '
   ```
   Every `unwrap()` in production code must have a comment explaining why it is unreachable. If any new uncommented `unwrap()` calls exist, they are a defect — file a follow-up or fix inline.
5. Check that the five new policy fields all have rustdoc comments.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- This bead does NOT modify any code. It only runs verification commands and reports failures.
- If any test suite fails: stop, report the failure with the exact test name and error message, and do NOT mark this bead closed.
- If clippy reports warnings: report the exact warning text. Do not suppress with `#[allow]` — fix the source.

**Subagent instructions:**
- This bead is single-threaded: run the commands sequentially, report all results.
- Do NOT modify test files to make failing tests pass. If a previously-passing test now fails due to the new code, that is a defect in the implementation beads — surface it to the human.

**Tests:** N/A — this bead is itself the validation step.
title: Regression: full test suite passes with all new policy fields
